name: 26866-jsonschema-1.7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), bf16, 40960-token window, ~3.4 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=800, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, seed static 23233.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 481 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens, both min == max. 100% of requests are constrained to one JSON schema -- `AnimalMetadataSchemaV2`, carried verbatim in `scenario.json` at `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.json` -- and the backend sets `ignore_eos` whenever it sets `max_tokens`, so every request emits exactly 128 tokens. Prompt bodies are drawn synthetically, so only their length is pinned, not their content.
purpose: A wildlife catalogue service extracting fixed JSON animal records from short prompts for 800 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine is the source checkout named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`, not a release.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# Load-bearing: with prefix caching on, requests sharing a prefix skip part of their prefill.
enable-prefix-caching: false

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Pinned deliberately -- do NOT drop these as "the defaults". The default depends on how the
# engine is constructed and can be eightfold smaller, at which the declared 800-stream
# operating point is never reached.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
